scripts.text: [Mother Mathana]
scripts.translation: [瑪薩娜修女]

scripts.text: I'm afraid there's something wrong with our old cemetery...
scripts.translation: 恐怕我們的古老墓地出了些問題...

scripts.text: But thanks to you, {0}, we'll be able to sleep {1} nights!
scripts.translation: 不過多虧了你，{0}，我們能安睡{1}個夜晚了！

scripts.text: But thanks to {0}'s support, we've got {1} easy nights!
scripts.translation: 多虧了{0}的幫助，我們已經有{1}個安穩的夜晚了！

scripts.text: THEY could return tomorrow's night again!
scripts.translation: 它們明晚可能又會回來！

scripts.text: Thank you, {0}! Now we'll manage to rest till the next midnight!
scripts.translation: 謝謝你，{0}！現在我們可以安穩休息到下一個午夜了！

scripts.text: But due to {0}'s help we'll manage to rest till the next midnight!
scripts.translation: 多虧了{0}的幫助，我們可以安穩休息到下一個午夜！

scripts.text: To calm down the restless cemetery, we should pour all these graves with the Holy Water. But our sisters and brothers have run out of it.
scripts.translation: 要安撫這座躁動的墓地，我們得把聖水灑遍所有墓穴。可是修女和修士們的聖水都用完了。

scripts.text: Could you supply us with Holy Water?
scripts.translation: 你能給我們一些聖水嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, have all my Holy Water!
scripts.translation: 好，我把所有聖水都給你們！

scripts.text: Nope, I need it.
scripts.translation: 不行，我自己還要用。

scripts.text: I don't have any.
scripts.translation: 我沒有聖水。

scripts.text: [Mother Mathana]
scripts.translation: [瑪薩娜修女]

scripts.text: Thank you, {0}! Now we've got enough Holy Water!
scripts.translation: 謝謝你，{0}！聖水已經夠用了！

scripts.text: [Mother Mathana]
scripts.translation: [瑪薩娜修女]

scripts.text: Upon pouring the cemetery with that water we'll get {0} safe nights!
scripts.translation: 把聖水灑遍墓地後，我們就能獲得{0}個安全的夜晚！

scripts.text: [Mother Mathana]
scripts.translation: [瑪薩娜修女]

scripts.text: See, {0}? They all are gone now!
scripts.translation: 你看，{0}？它們全都消失了！

scripts.text: [Mother Mathana]
scripts.translation: [瑪薩娜修女]

scripts.text: Our Church is going to thank you personally...
scripts.translation: 教會會親自感謝你的...

scripts.text: [Mother Mathana]
scripts.translation: [瑪薩娜修女]

scripts.text: In the name of Odin we bless you and decently present a modest gift just from Mareusis' wine-cellar.
scripts.translation: 我們奉奧丁之名祝福你，並從馬雷烏西斯的酒窖中奉上一份薄禮。

scripts.text: [Mother Mathana]
scripts.translation: [瑪薩娜修女]

scripts.text: Thank you, good {0}, but we still need {1} more Holy Water bottles.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你，善良的{0}，不過我們還需要{1}瓶聖水。

scripts.text: [Mother Mathana]
scripts.translation: [瑪薩娜修女]

scripts.text: I'm afraid the old cemetery is going out of control soon... Please, get us all the Holy Water you can get.
scripts.translation: 恐怕古老墓地很快就要失控了...請儘可能多地為我們帶來聖水。

scripts.text: [Mother Mathana]
scripts.translation: [瑪薩娜修女]

scripts.text: Alas! We still need {0} more bottles of Holy Water...  Why don't you go and ask other people for some extra Holy Water?
scripts.translation: 唉！我們還需要{0}瓶聖水...你能去問問其他人，看看他們是否有多餘的聖水嗎？

scripts.text: The old cemetery is going out of control soon...
scripts.translation: 古老墓地很快就要失控了...

scripts.text: Please, in the name of Odin, help Prontera city.
scripts.translation: 請看在奧丁的份上，幫助普隆德拉城。
